model: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next UD-IQ4_XS with its Q8_0 MTP draft
method: The prompt interval follows the application log from request start through the prompt-eval completion. GPU kernel time is the sum of CUPTI kernel durations, not GPU wall time; overlapping kernels are counted separately. The GDN-path total includes gdn_single and ssm_conv_long_token_f32 only. Decode kernels are excluded.
decision: No measured GDN hot-path gap. Do not review or port PR 26001 on this evidence; revisit only if a representative longer-prompt trace shows materially greater GDN share.
limitations: One 10000-character prompt profile, with 2734 actual tokens.
This is an operator-share measurement, not a speed comparison or a model-throughput claim.
Other generic kernels are not attributed to GDN.
